source: PRA SS1/23 Model risk management principles for banks (current version effective 23 April 2026)

stages.gate: Approve extracted model information and the risk tier
principles: 1. Model identification and model risk classification
stages.modeltrace_provides: Inventory record and risk tier for each model
Model card built from verified metadata and actual results

stages.gate: Approve the migration candidate and test readiness
stages.modeltrace_provides: Python migration with parity tests against the R model
Separate Validation Agent; the Migration Agent cannot certify its own work

stages.gate: Approve monitoring configuration and operational readiness
stages.modeltrace_provides: Drift alerts with human review, escalation and a recommendation on re-validation

all_stages.modeltrace_provides: Human approval gates and audit log
